content.text: Almost. Canadian guidance is to start solids around 6 months, and Theo is 5 months. Until then, breast milk or formula is all he needs. Around 6 months, look for signs he's ready: sitting with support, good head control, and interest in your food. When he's there, start with iron-rich foods like iron-fortified cereal or well-cooked, mashed meat or beans. Check timing with your provider or public health.
